Geometry-derived analysis shows Mn centers in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while Ho centers have eight O neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Mn octahedra and between Mn octahedra and Ho polyhedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites.
